title: Turn the LTP into an implementation plan and beads
description: Using the reviewed LTP (goal tree, current reality, the sharing-vs-thinking conflict, injections and candidate assumptions), write an implementation plan for the first good set and break it into beads with bd dep ordering. Set a new target date. Cover the open questions: views, depth and density per use, answers, text shortening, formats and sizes, interactivity, themes, pipeline, self-checks, test set (Wise AI, Seeds of Renaissance rebrand tree).
acceptance_criteria: Plan in docs/plans/, beads created and ordered, new target date in the SCQ or epic.

title: First good set of tree visuals
description: Goal (from the SCQ, docs/plans/2026-10-19-tree-render-scq.md): reliably and quickly turn any question or hypothesis tree into a visual that is good information design and compelling enough to share, for both thinking together and sharing publicly. First milestone: 2–3 formats and 2 themes, good enough to post as they are. The original 2026-11-02 target has passed; set a new one when planning.

title: Write the LTP report for the tree-render candidate
description: reports/ltp/tree-render/tree-render.ltp.yaml has no report yet. Follow the ltp-project skill (~/src/life-itself/reasoncommons/skills/ltp-project/, references/report.md) and write reports/ltp/tree-render/tree-render.report.md: items table, relationships with the sentence that asserts each, deliberately omitted, judgment calls, validator output (not machine-validated), not in this file. Also map every open question in the SCQ issue tree (L44-64) to the entity or assumption it would settle. Goal tree already reviewed with Rufus 2026-11-07 (deadline moved to plan, skill-before-tool is an approach, two uses added as CSFs) — record that.
acceptance_criteria: Report exists beside the YAML with every section filled; the three or four judgment calls Rufus should check first are listed at the top.

title: Check the renderer runs on the remote machine
description: skills/tree-mindmap/scripts/mindmap.sh renders JSON → HTML → headless Chrome → SVG and PNG with embedded Apfel Grotezk fonts. Confirm it runs on the remote machine (Chrome or Chromium available, fonts found) using examples/q2-mindmap.json, and note any setup in the skill.
acceptance_criteria: examples/q2-mindmap.json renders to SVG and PNG on the remote machine; setup steps written in SKILL.md.
close_reason: Not needed: clean start from the LTP, the draft renderer is prior art and was not moved here
